To: the NYC Department of Transportation (NYC DOT)
Cc: Council Member, District 41, New York City Council; Brooklyn Community Board 9
Subject: Request for focused safety review at East New York Avenue & Remsen Avenue

Dear colleagues at NYC DOT,

I am writing to request a fresh safety review at the junction of East New York Avenue & Remsen Avenue.

The official record for the 5 years from 31 October 2021 lists 1 reported crash at this junction. That crash resulted in no pedestrian injuries, no cyclist injuries, and no person killed is recorded, with 0 crashes involving injury in total. No dollar value for yearly harm is reported for this site in the 2024 U.S. DOT values. This location is flagged as a city priority location.

No recent completed safety project is listed in the official record for this site in this period, and no planned safety project is shown.

As the agency responsible for East New York Avenue and for Remsen Avenue, I would ask you to study the site and set out near-term changes on the roads you own, subject to what a site check shows is feasible.

Thank you for your work to protect all road users.

Yours sincerely,

[Your name]
[Your organisation or address]
